title: Concept: Content-Security-Policy connect-src allows every origin
description: A policy permits outbound connections to any origin. connect-src is the directive that bounds exfiltration: with a wildcard, a single injected script can post the session to an attacker host without violating the policy, which defeats the purpose of a strict script-src.
applicability: HTML responses that deliver a Content-Security-Policy header.
risk: Data exfiltration channel from injectable pages; MEDIUM severity.
